image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Fourth Quarter, Fiscal 2025
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended March 31, 2025, and the year ended March 31, 2025, extracted from the IFRS financial statement. It details key financial metrics such as revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, comparing figures from the current year to the previous year. Notable insights include a year-over-year revenue growth of 7.9% for the quarter and 6.1% for the year, alongside a decline in net profit for the quarter by 11.7%. The operating margin for the quarter is reported at 21.0%, with a slight decrease from the previous year. The table also highlights the dividend per share, which increased by 13.2% for the year.
